svg.title: Below-decks arrangement with every space given a use
svg.desc: Plan and side view of the schooner's below-decks arrangement, drawn from the built ship. The captain's cabin aft has its furniture at the low sides and a clear standing strip on the centreline; a pantry and spirit locker flank a short ship's ladder; the wardroom carries the mainmast, the pump well, a mess table with a form each side, runs of chests along both sides, and the mate's and surgeon's cabins flanking the hatchway; the forecastle holds the galley hearth to port, its dresser to starboard, a hinged table at the foremast and four berths in two tiers in the bow; and the peak is the sail and boatswain's store.
svg.text: Plan — front of the ship on the right. 49.3 m² of walkable floor, drawn from the built ship.
Side view — and what is under each floor
